notes.title: July 29 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Minor text and bug fixes.
 Added "Visit" button to Europe map. However it is work in progress at the moment.


If you have recommendations for future, please share it in the comments.

notes.title: 12 March 2025 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added a party logo featuring a cat.
 Secretary bonuses have been adjusted, again.
 Added 10x and 100x options when donating to the state budget.
 Added a decision that can be made after taking control of the whole of Syria. (A simple quest chain that follows this decision will be added in a future update).
 Reduced the cost of operations in Syria.
 Fixed a few bugs related to Syria.
 Fixed several text and text parameter bugs.
 Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash.

notes.title: March 3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Syria has been added. (As of the first half of 2024, you can access Syria by clicking on it via "Syria & Iraq" when you are on map of Turkey)
 Now, instead of going to rallies yourself you can assign your mayoral candidate in the province (after reaching a certain number of votes nationwide).
 Added minor events triggered when interest groups reach 50% influence.
 Minor changes to rally fees.
 Rally results now have a randomized payoff instead of a fixed vote gain/loss (e.g. a perfect rally now has a vote gain between +2% and +4.5% instead of a fixed +4%).
 Reduced the speed of boosting international relations.
 Reduced the slot for improving international relations from 3 to 2.
 Secretary bonuses have been balanced.
 Added new party logos.
 Added new party colors.
 Added texture filtering to the avatar window and avatars in the dialog box. (Glare caused by scale differences has been fixed.)
 The base text color has been set to a slightly lighter color, so that the color highlights will appear relatively more prominent.
 Updated the color codes in the text template, meaningless spaces in the hint boxes will disappear significantly.


Bug Fixes

 The height at which dialog boxes appear has been increased. They will now appear a little higher on the screen (Dialog boxes are intended to center the screen).
 Fixed a bug where provinces that were neither visited nor rallied at the end of the year were gaining votes when they should have been losing votes.
 A few text corrections were made in Turkish and English.
 Fixed a bug that prevented chips from spawning with empty clue boxes.
 Fixed a bug with clue boxes appearing when the Buildings window was open.
 Edited some texts manually so that they do not spill out of the hint boxes.
 Added descriptions of missing provinces (for photos and descriptions of provinces you can send your own photos or your own text!)
 Numerous text corrections have been made in all languages.


In the next update, the “Early Access” period will end with international visits and a few simple edits and finishing touches. Don't forget to leave your requests in the comments!

notes.title: October 24 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added few of the missing province descriptions.
 Fixed some text translations.
 Fixed some UI text alignments.


Since I am working on a two new projects, I could not find enough time to bring new features. Sorry for that. So, please leave your recommendations below regarding upcoming updates. If you have any request, you should share so I can update the game accordingly.

notes.title: September 7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added Chinese Language. (There is an unknown bug on visuals on tooltip boxes and dialog windows, I could not figure out the reason. Some texts and boxes look extremely ugly at the moment)
 Few minor bug fixes.
 Removed unnecessary fonts from game files and minor text adjustments.

notes.title: August 17 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Now AI parties lose or gain relations with each other. So you can expect new alliance combinations to appear over time.
 Fixed some events to spawn instantly instead of popping up as notification.

notes.title: August 13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Now "Visits and Rallies" map mode gets updated once you visit the province. You do not need to re-click on the map mode button.
 Decreased chance of Earthquake event slightly.
 Fixed a bug which was causing visit counter to increase when player does not have enough visit points or budget.
 Fixed a bug which was causing game to crash on launch and on next week.

notes.title: July 31 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added "Visits and Rallies" map mode. Which allows you to check which provinces you have visit or held rally within the year.
 By the end of the year, provinces without any visits or rallies will cause you to lose support.
 Adjusted 2 of the latest map mode icon locations.
 Added one new achievement related with province visits and rallies.
 Added explanation for 2 of the existing achievements, which had no explanation how to get, earlier.
 Fixed a bug which caused same event to keep appearing every 7 weeks once you are president.
 Minor hovertip adjustments.
 Multiple text and code adjustments.

notes.title: July 24 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added buildings map mode.
 Fixed an issue which caused rally/meeting to be made for free.
 Building a structure in a province now does not closes the "Buildings" window.
 State budget now can go below zero. (But nothing happens to punish.)
 Changed "Mayor" map mode icon.
 Minor adjustments on map mode hovertips.

notes.title: July 16 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Now Red Party leader changes (if not changed yet) on week 43.
 Now municipal elections affects fame of the selected mayor.
 Now every election causes party leaders to gain fame if they are succeeding in the elections. For example winning mayor of İstanbul makes a party leader to gain 4.5 fame, winning presidency in first round brings 12 fame while second round is 10 fame and so on.
 Game title in main menu is now bigger and cooler. Please do not right click.
 Fixed a case which caused player party corruption to go below zero.
 Fixed a case which caused game to crash.
 Fixed few minor typos.

notes.title: July 8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added political spectrum. A visual graph for politics enthusiatists.
 Now every related event decision will affect player party's political standing, check it out via Political Spectrum window.
 Armenia-Azerbaijan conflict trigger now resets every 4 year. (So you can obtain both achievements in a single run.)
 Very minor text and code adjustments.

notes.title: July 5 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
You can now go to next week using "Space" key.
 You can now disable gazette pop-ups, via "Parties" screen. (It will be there for now)
 Adjusted some of the event decisions. (Vote affect, party budget cost et cetera.)
 Remove corruption option (from one of the triggerable event decisions) now removes most of the corruption (55%) as the description, previously it was removing half of the corruption.
 Made preparations to the upcoming political spectrum update. (Now more event, almost every, decisions affects your party's ideology.)

notes.title: July 4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Minor code and text adjustments.
 Dialog header coordination and color adjustments.
 Added a new, and first, international event chain related with Armenia - Azerbaijan conflict. Which can occur.
 Added 2 new achievements, related with Azerbaijan - Armenia conflict event.
 Added 2 new notification icons.
 Added political spectrum stats. At the moment some of the decisions affect your party's political orientation, which will be visually visible within upcoming updates.

notes.title: June 30 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Minor text and code adjustments.
 Rally speed increased by 10%.
 You can now adjust your own mayoral candidates' names. (Yes, not a DLC-only feature.)
 Bad rally will result in 1.5% vote lose within the province while successfull rally will cause 2.5% increase and perfect rally will cause 4% increase. (It was -0.5%, 3.1%, 4.1% earlier.)
 Ban Abortion Act now affects population growth of the provinces. If it is active, population growth will be decrease by 30%.

notes.title: June 28 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Minor text adjustments.
 Adjusted MP convince costs.
 Adjusted some of the secretary bonuses.
 EU Tradezone Act is now available to vote in the parliament.
 After rejecting EU-related events, it was impossible to reapply to the EU process. If you now click on the 'Apply EU' button, you will be able to resubmit EU-related events in the coming weeks.


And I need your feedback about the game balance. Thanks for your interest into Turkish politics!

notes.title: June 27 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes: Added 7 new achievements related with EU.

notes.title: June 26 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Added option to join EU along with some preconditions and events.

notes.title: June 17 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added 3 triggerable international (EU actually) events. (Triggered every few weeks if the player is president)
 Minor general adjustments. (text & code)


Detailed international paths for players to follow up upcoming, slowly, butkeep in touch!..

notes.title: June 12 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added "May 1" Event.
 Added 3 basic international interaction buttons; "Improve Relations", "Apply Sanctions", "Offer Bilateral Alliance".(Future updates will build on these basic mechanics, even if they don't make much sense at the moment...)

notes.title: June 4 Patch Notes - Keyboard Shortcuts
notes.notes:
Added keyboard shortcut for dialogue options. Use 1,2,3,4,5 on your keyboard to select the response to an event. (This may not work for some answers, such as some warnings or some old, rare dialogue pop-ups, but in general it will work well for most dialogues).
 Added shortcuts for map modes. Use F1-F7 to switch between map modes.
 Added 1 province visit event.
 Minor text and province tooltip adjustments.

notes.title: May 25 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Now, at the end of the year, the economy of the provinces grows at the same rate as the population.
 The "Prosperity" of the country is now calculated by taking into account the population of all provinces. (Prosperity-enhancing laws have also been adjusted accordingly.)
 The relationship with favoured interest groups develops more rapidly and their influence grows faster (about 40 per cent).
 Fixed an issue with switching to fullscreen. (Finally!)
 Fixed an issue where province happiness was dropping too quickly based on wealth.

notes.title: May 20 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Happiness adjustments and fixes related laws. (now, again, laws affect provincal happiness. (It was affecting countrywide happiness so it had almost no affect because countrywide happiness were no longer used.)
 Province happiness is now more dynamic.
 Made multiple text corrections.
 Minor game optimizations.

notes.title: May 16 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added "Income Per Capita" stat to the provinces.
 "Income Per Capita" now affects happiness of a province.
 Added new map mode: "Prosperity", stands for "Income Per Capita". (I know, they are different in real life, but it is just a game.)
 Now a province will have a chance to shift votes to the ruling party according to their income per capita. A higher "Income Per Capita" value will reward the ruling party, lower value will cause them to lose votes. This will happen in random amount of provinces, every week.
 "Income Per Capita" also affects happiness of a province apart from the vote shift.
 Added "Cancel Improve Relations" function.
 Added 2 new achievements.
 Fixed a game load bug which causes every province to set their GDP to a fixed value. However this fix will not affect broken values which exists already.
 Also, several minor fixes which does not worth to mention here.

notes.title: May 9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added 8 new achievements.
 Fixed an economic growth bug that caused the economy to increase by a factor of 100 instead of what it should have.
 Now province happiness may decrease in provinces with a chance if the economy per capita is too low.
 Minor text and tooltip corrections.
 Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: May 4 Patch Notes - Buildings
notes.notes:
Added BUILDINGS, 7 of them!
 Added happiness to every province, now state happiness counted regarding to provincal happiness every week.
 Added provincal happiness map mode.
 Provincal happiness affects votes of the current mayor's party within the province.
 Added a game rule that disallows player party to propose laws into parliament when having less than 20 MPs.
 Adjusted icon sizes of currencies such as "State Budget", "Democracy", "Military Power" and so on.
 Removed "Stability" from the active currencies, added "Science" instead.
 Changed "Corruption" icon with better one which is more fit.
 Added some new achievements.

notes.title: May 2 Patch Notes - Parliamentary Visual Overhaul
notes.notes:
Updated The Parliament, which looks more minimalistic now.
 Adjusted MP convince chances and prices.
 The space between Province Interact buttons have been adjusted.
 Code optimisations for both the parliament and law voting.



https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2496759670485469236/10EBC2F6779C266D19BCF35A85D2CF3D7947FDA0/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

notes.title: April 30 - Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added 9 new laws.
 Adjusted some of the law modifiers.
 Happiness icon now displays correct emotion regarding to the people's happiness.
 Red Party now starts with 4 election investment tokens in Ankara.
 Slightly increased province investment costs, especially "Party Influence" cost.
 Some minor code fixes and text corrections.


Apart from these, I'm working on the "Building" system. When the buildings are completed, we will continue with the International Relations section.

notes.title: April 28 Patch Notes - All 81 Provinces!
notes.notes:
Yalova and Kilis added! Now we have all 81 provinces of Turkey!
 Added 3 new achievements.
 Now some parties start with investment tokens in some of their most popular provinces.
 The chances of making a joint candidates have been adjusted slightly. The party with more popularity in a province has a higher chance of convincing its ally to support its candidate. (It means that you will less likely see a Purple Party mayor in İstanbul or Red Party mayor in Van for example.)
 Players will not be able to propose laws in the first week of the first year.
 Reduced the possible supporter income from some events, such as Earthquake and Refugee Crisis.
 Fixed a bug that was preventing players from voting on laws even if they had not decided to propose the bill, but had simply clicked on it.
 Fixed a bug that caused the Purple Party to invest in the same province over and over again.

notes.title: April 27 Patch Notes - Bug Fixes Only!
notes.notes:
Finally you can remove a law if there are more than 360 approvals during the law removal voting phase. This took a really long time to fix, sorry about that!
 Fixed several law removal bugs.
 Fixed 2 bugs that crashed the game.
 Fixed 1 typo in Turkish.
 Backend adjustments for laws, cooking it for the upcoming update.

notes.title: April 25 Patch Notes - Starting to Balance & Request
notes.notes:
Before we move on to today's update notes...
I'm currently focusing on balancing state related currencies such as law balances, purchasing power, democracy, and so on. The balancing part is more difficult than adding a new mechanic. Therefore, I need your feedback on what needs to change about the balancing of the state currencies shown above the map. 
For example; the state budget is broken, it increases too easily; purchasing power is too unbalanced, this value increases too fast, this plus or minus in this law is too unbalanced.
Suggestions for new laws are also welcome.
Any opinion is important and welcome, especially for the balancing of democracy, purchasing power, state budget, stability, military power, etc., which should be the focus after the election of the President.



 Corruption now affects party performance. When there is too much corruption in your party, you are more likely to experience bad events such as losing investment tokens, losing support in a random province and so on.
 A “Donate to Government” button has been added to the “Parties” section, allowing the player to donate their budget to the government. Currently, 10 party budgets are equal to approximately 1 state budget.
 Removed the Confirm button that was used to return from a vote on a bill or repeal bill in the parliament before it was finalized. The Confirm button will reappear after the voting process is complete.
 Mayoral ownership achievements are now checked every week in addition to the election results, to allow the player to achieve achievements in some rare cases outside of elections.
 Bug fixes have been made for the “National Football Team” event, which was causing many issues such as crashes and incorrect provinces.
 Added that the player needs 360 MPs to remove a law in the law removal dialog.
 Text and hint adjustments and fixes.

notes.title: April 23 Patch Notes - Bug Fixes, Finally!
notes.notes:
The first week of every year is now a holiday for MPs! So the Parliament is inaccessible. (Actually, this was a technical necessity.)
 The population of each province now grows by 1% at the end of each year (I will adjust the population growth to the actual growth rate of each province later).
 Fixed a few bugs that caused MPs to appear as X.
 Fixed a few bugs that caused some parties' MPs to not appear at all if there was at least one party without MPs.
 Fixed a bug in the "Laws" section that caused the Law buttons to appear at the top of the dialog window.
 Fixed a bug that caused player MPs to reject their own party's law removal proposals.
 Fixed a few other minor bugs that I forgot to mention here.
 Despite all the bug fixes, there might be some rare cases that I didn't encounter during my testing phase. If you see any bugs, please get in touch as soon as possible via the Steam forums or our Discord server.

notes.title: April 21 Mini Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The fame of presidential candidates now affects the votes they get in presidential elections.
 A bunch of new party icons have been added.
 Some party icon colors have been changed to less bright ones. Also new ones have been added. (Your party colors may have changed when you load your save game, change them in the "Parties" section. Sorry for the inconvenience!)
 The "Calendar" and "Next Week" buttons are now bright to attract new players.
 The "Calendar" section now shows the current week in green.
 Added a button to reduce party corruption in the "Parties" section (but corruption, for now, does not affect many thing. Future updates may include corruption related stuff).
 Fixed a few transcription and localization errors.

notes.title: April 20 Patch Notes - New Logo Editor & DLC
notes.notes:
Party logo editor added! Now you can set your own party logo, background color and logo color! (New logos and colors will be coming in the upcoming days, please share your logo and color suggestions!)
 Party leaders and mayors now age over time.
 Fixed a major hover hint bug that in some cases would spawn forever and cause the game to freeze until the mouse cursor was moved away.
 Fixed a bug that prevented counting the number of province visits. You can now earn the 81 visits achievement. (You don't have to visit every province once, the total visit number counts)
 A cosmetic DLC was also released that allows you to edit the abbreviation and full names of all parties! Visit it in the Steam store.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2946730/

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2500136102379438170/A7432D9F68EE45E7B76A7E31C9D0431DF8902A5D/?imw=1024&imh=455&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true

notes.title: April 19 Patch Notes - Mayor Transfers
notes.notes:
You can now convince other mayoral candidates to join your party.
 The distribution of municipalities and votes has been supplemented with up-to-date data for most provinces.
 The Purple Party will now most likely invest in Eastern Anatolia and in some specific metropolises.
 Added 5 new achievements related to mayor interactions.
 A few hint updates and text corrections.
 A few bug and logical fixes.
 Turquoise Party logo has been changed.

 Added a support DLC that will give you the option to edit AI party names and abbreviations, including the player party abbreviation. (DLC will be available in Steam in a few days.)

notes.title: April 16 Patch Notes - Appointing New Candidates
notes.notes:
From now on, when nominating a new mayor in a province, there will be consequences related to the candidate's fame, power and ownership of the province.
 If the replaced mayor is too popular or current mayor of the province, they will seek a way to join another party.
 The weekly mayor replacement limit has been reduced from 2 to 1.
 The effect of candidates' fame in mayoral elections has been readjusted.
 The fame selection algorithm of new candidates has been adjusted, it is possible to see candidates with more stable fame.
 Each party now loses or gains between -1% and +1% of vote in a random city every week. Thus, the votes of the parties can dynamically increase or decrease independently of the player.
 The Red Party will now increase its vote share over time. (Let me know in the comments if you don't like this part!)
 Ten new colours to choose from as party color.
 One new advertisement option has been added.
 Adjusted the price and reward of existing advertisement options.
 Advertising on billboards in player-owned municipalities will cost 30% less than in non-player-owned municipalities.
 Fixed a game loading process that caused the game to crash.

notes.title: April 14 Patch Notes - The Mayors
notes.notes:
April 14

 The player party can now appoint a new mayoral candidate for the upcoming elections. (Currently, when the player appoints a new candidate for a province where they have already taken the mayorship, it also changes the mayor. This will be adjusted in the next update to cause trouble for the player)
 The reputation of mayoral candidates now influences election results. The mayoral candidate with the highest reputation gets more votes than his/her party would normally get in higher municipal elections, the mayoral candidate with the lowest reputation loses votes for his/her party). But remember, mayoral candidates' fame does not apply to mayoral polls! (This was something that was requested, a lot of people requested that surveys to not give exact results, so I left it that way. If you think surveys should continue to give results very close to elections, please mention it in the comments section of this devlog).
 Mayoral candidates now have power along with fame and age. With power, they can be a problem for their party when they leave it.
 Fixed bugs that caused more than a dozen games to crash, including sending an alliance proposal to a party with a negative relationship causing the game to crash.
 Fixed some localisation typos and made some hints more informative.
 Added a developer message that appears when the game is launched for the first time.


The upcoming updates will include:

 Other parties will also be able to hold rallies, so they too will dynamically gain or lose votes every week!
 If the current mayor has very high power and fame, but the player party appoints a new candidate to replace the current mayor, the province may lose votes.
 Appointing a candidate of lower power to replace the current mayoral candidate may cause your mayoral candidate to join another party with less fame or power.
 The ability to persuade another party's mayoral candidate to join your party.

notes.title: April 12 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Last week I was working on the "International Relations" mechanics, but after our poll with you resulted in over 70% in favour of "Mayoral Interactions", I changed my focus to "Mayoral Interactions". Since the International Relations update includes endgame mechanics, I will focus on the early and mid-game mechanics, such as "Mayoral Interactions", "Ideological Background and Trends".


 Preparations have been made for the upcoming Mayoral interactions update (you can check the mayoral candidates, but you can't interact with them yet).
 Fixed a weird bug where if the most two of the popular presidential candidates were in an alliance, none of them would make it to the second round of the elections. (Now if the two most popular parties are in an alliance and make it to the second round, the alliance is broken)
 The population of Eskisehir has been corrected.
 Fixed a large number of bugs related to alliance offers and agreements.
 A few fixes have been made regarding event options causing the game to crash.
 Fixed several localisation and spelling errors.

notes.title: April 8-9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added KATO, EU and Relations map modes into Europe.
 A minor improvement has been made so that the percentages of the parties with a vote rate exceeding 50% in the survey results are not written outside the screen.
 Added a new event chain that can be randomly triggered weekly.
 Added several new party logos.
 Fixed a bug that caused incorrect display of votes in the 2nd round of the presidential election.

notes.title: April 6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Newspaper font changed.
 Updated AI party logos. (Expect the background of the player party logo to change to match the colour of the player party in future updates).
 Added an option to exit the party edit screen.
 Fixed a bug that made the game unclickable if the player spammed the left mouse button before the newspaper was fully revealed.
 Fixed many typos and bad localisations in both Turkish and English.
 Fixed a bug with the election investment map mode description.


PS: I am currently working on 2 major mechanics, which may take relatively long time due to their weight (interaction with mayors and interaction with international countries).

notes.title: April 5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
You can now take screenshots and share them on Steam.
 Newspaper has been added. For now, news is only available before and after elections, newspaper news may be added under other circumstances in the future...
 Reduced the time to wait when an alliance rejects an offer from 20 weeks to 10 weeks.
 Fixed an election calculation bug that caused the game to crash.
 Adjusted the chance of some events.

notes.title: April 3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added vote history. (It is updated every 8 weeks, so if you use this option in the first weeks you may see very low votes!)
 Fixed a bug that was causing rallies to not have a "Perfect Result". (This bug was causing rallies to have a "Good" or "Bad" result, now they can have a "Perfect" result).
 Secretary background color now matches the player party color.
 Increased the military power of some countries. (This is still in the development phase, there may be many changes in the coming days).

notes.title: April 2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This is the main part of the update I have been working on for about a week. Interaction with the European part is not active at the moment, it will be active in the coming days.


 EUROPE ADDED. (Even if you can't interact with other countries yet, they are there. There are some small mechanics that will be added to Europe soon!)
 PLAYER PARTY COLOR SELECTION ADDED! (Already have a party set up? Don't worry, you can go to the "Parties" section and edit your party there!)
 A new map mode called "Election Investment" has been added, allowing players to track their election investments.
 Now when moving to the next week, province majority values will be updated accordingly.
 Changed the rally background color to dark. (The whole rally system needs an overhaul, I'm aware of that, one day...)
 Numerous localization and typo fixes.
 Added a notification that pops up when the game is saved.
 Added multiple new party names to the party name pool, removed one.
 Added a notification sound that plays when there is a notification when moving to next week.
 Added a sound effect that plays when the player tries to go to next week when there are unanswered notifications.
 Limited weekly law voting to 1. (Note that laws still don't affect your votes!)
 Added 2 new party logos.
 Fixed a bug which made player unable to click on election days.


Note: This update took about a week because adding new countries was a lot of work. Future updates will continue to come more frequently as before!

notes.title: Path to Full Release
notes.notes:
The game will receive updates to include the following 3 main mechanics until full release.

Ideological Tendencies
Shaped by the decisions taken and will be able to offer new options to the player in many areas.
Mayors
Direct interaction with the mayors will enable a more detailed election preparation.
International Relations
More decisions, international interaction and progress after becoming President.

Apart from these main mechanics, minor fixes and additions will continue to come every few days.

Feel free to share your opinions in the comments or in the Steam discussions section, peace be with you.

notes.title: March 26 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Significantly increased AI parties' chance to accept player alliance offer. (Might adjust it later, perhaps?..)
 Now target party will accept player alliance offers if they are unallied, have positive relations and all other parties are allied.
 Added 4 different warning messages for the player, telling what to do. (Spend Joint Tokens, spend Investment Tokens, organise Visit to provinces and spend less money on advertising.)
 Added 4 new achievements! (related with one above.)
 Added one new triggerable event. (Turquoise related! Ally them and max out relations to encounter this one.)
 Increased chances for non-allied parties to request joint candidates when improving relations.
 If the party with whom the player is improving relations has formed an alliance, they will no longer ask for a common candidate.
 A game limiter was added to ensure that after the parliamentary elections, each party has at least 1 member of parliament. (However, it is still recommended not to convince the entire party to join you because that would break the game calculations!)
 Added party edit screen, a copy of party creation screen, where you can change your party name, party logo, leader name and secretary!
 Party creation screen no longer locks you to preset leader names, you can input a manual name.
 Fixed a bug related with party name input, which caused player input to not set correctly.
 Removed the requirement of Parliamentary Elections to visit Parliament and Laws.
 Corrected the issue that the Orange Party's leader had 40 fame instead of 140. (However, fame has nothing to do yet.) Made multiple typo corrections.
 If you press the "Shift" key when clicking on the "Create Party" button, you will no longer have the silly tutorial introduction.

notes.title: March 25 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an caused president to be always Purple Party's leader. (That's shame I noticed this problem after 12 days of the launch, sorry!)
 Adjusted Presidental achievements to make sure the player gets the achievement within the first leg of the route.
 Fixed multiple issues related with fall down events. (I hope this time there are no bugs left...)
 Known Issue: When a party has no member in the parliament, the game will act weird. (So do not try to convince them all to join to your party until further fixes regarding to this.)
 Fixed a visual bug caused player secretary to appear in different form.
 Added multiple extra tooltip lines into strings.


You can also participate in the survey at the link below to decide the next update regarding your content and mechanic requests. (Only 3 questions!)
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1sO0L1p1m3tSyCDbQkKwvTFSmdLwZY3Dgo2FwJh_skj0

notes.title: March 24 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug caused game to crash when declining incoming alliance offer.
 Fixed a dozen of bug related with party fall down events which caused game to spawn same event every day.
 Removed forgotten debug code which was activated via keyboard, which caused players to have Socialists influence above 40%.

notes.title: First Poll - Decide on the next update!
notes.notes:
It has been like 10 day since the game has been released. There were minor new content and a few mechanics added, also a dozen of bug fixes. As promised, now time to ask your opinions about the upcoming update!

Please participate in the poll below. (Until March 30)
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1sO0L1p1m3tSyCDbQkKwvTFSmdLwZY3Dgo2FwJh_skj0

notes.title: March 23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Allowed players to access to State section without any restrictions.
 Interest groups now have actual benefits when good relations are maintained!
 Added 6 new achievements related with interest groups!
 Fixed an issue related with interest group influence min max limits.
 Fixed an issue related with interest group influence displays.
 Fixed an issue related with interest groups having permanent static values.
 Slightly reduced weekly chance of incoming joint candidate request when improving relations with a party.

notes.title: March 21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added an informative suggestion at the start of the game, telling the player to improve relations with a party. (The game can be difficult without allies!..)
 Added an incoming alliance offer! Now all non-allied parties with good relations (above 40) will send you an alliance offer in weeks 10 and 25!
 Added a text warning to players in the party creation screen, informing them that they can only use randomised names for the party leader. (Sorry!)
 Added 4 new party logos. (You can expect your party logo to change after loading a save game from previous version.)
 Added multiple randomised party names to the party name pool.
 Fixed issue with fall down events; if a new revolt succeeds in AI-led parties, their leaders will change.

notes.title: Early Access Release & Roadmap
notes.notes:
Peace to you all!

While it's still playable as early access, there are a few more mechanics in development and in the draft stage. Let's take a look at them.

Large Scale Drafts

International Relations
The main goal in the game right now is to come to power. However, after coming to power, international relations will add more depth to the game, as well as agreements and trade with countries regionally.

Cross-Border Operations
Conflicts and operations, one of the unwritten rules of geography, are also one of the content updates in the draft stage.

EU Integration
It doesn't have to be a hit and run! A more peaceful and relatively more sacrificial integration system, with direct interaction with the European Parliament and its members... No more details. :P


More Flawless Gameplay Drafts

More Interactions
You may have noticed that in some cases there is too much detail and limited interaction in these" details". More interaction in various fields is coming soon...

Buildings and Province Development
We can gain income from cities, but this income does not change except for a small number of limited events. New interaction options and buildings(yes!) where you can directly contribute to the development of cities will increase the depth of the game.

More Random Events
One of the first parts of the roadmap is to increase the number and impact of events that occur under certain conditions.


It is up to you to decide which of the above-mentioned drafts should be prioritized. Don't forget to stay tuned!
